# Tier `blackwell-3x16`

## Serving

| setting | value | what it controls |
|---|---|---|
| backend | `triple-blackwell` | which `llama-swap.*.yaml` template renders |
| ctx_size | 131072 | the served window (`--ctx-size`) |
| kv_type | `q8_0` | `--cache-type-k/v`, kept symmetric |
| flash_attn | `on` | `--flash-attn` (required for a q8_0 V cache) |
| resident_tier | `gemma4-26b-a4b` | the model that stays hot; seeds the agent planner seat (agent_model) when it differs from the workhorse |
| agent_ctx_tokens | 131072 | the agent's `-ctx-tokens` compaction budget |
| 26B-A4B | `gpu` | whether the 26B MoE is served, and where its experts live |

## Media

This tier serves these media **seats** — models in its own llama-swap config, rendered
at install time. Each seat also produces the harness config binding that routes to it, so a
binding can never name a seat that was not rendered:

| seat | kind | binds | model | residency |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `qwen3-vl-32b` | vision | `vision_model` | `Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf` | swappable |
| `qwen3-vl-8b` | ocr | `ocr_model` | `Qwen3VL-8B-Instruct-Q8_0.gguf` | swappable |
| `whisper-stt` | stt | `stt_model` | `ggml-large-v3-turbo.bin` | resident |

A seat still needs its weights on the box — model downloads stay out-of-band, as with
every seed.

## Operator notes

Recorded with the profile — several are measurements from real hardware,
including reasons a tempting change was deliberately not made.

> Config #17 (3x homogeneous Blackwell 16GB = 48.9 GB; the reference box IS the workstation: RTX 5060 Ti @17:00.0 + RTX 5070 Ti @65:00.0 + RTX 5060 Ti @B5:00.0, X299 / i9-10980XE, quad-channel DDR4-3400 128GB). SHIPPED 0.113.32 (2026-09-07) after the operator asked three times. Before this tier existed the fleet's MOST-measured machine had no tier id at all and Get-Profile filed it as `dual-gpu` -- a tier no hardware has ever run and that the installer refuses to install (CUDA 13 cannot compile sm_70) -- so a fresh install on the box that produces most of the fleet's numbers would have seeded a pure projection. THE THIRD CARD BUYS CONTEXT AND CONCURRENCY, NOT A BIGGER POOLED MODEL (operator directive). Measured: llama.cpp's 3-way aggregate ceiling is 134.4 tok/s at c32 against the pair's 110-120 (+10-20%), and pipeline-parallel vLLM is about 8% SLOWER single-stream than tensor-parallel on two cards because the stages serialize. What it actually buys is KV pool -- 137,898 tokens across three cards versus 78,506 across two -- and headroom. PLACEMENT LAW, measured and load-bearing: anything that fits two cards runs on the 5060 Ti PAIR (devices 0 and 2); the RTX 5070 Ti is the DISPLAY card and stays interactive-first, joining only for over-2-card work, under a >=4 GiB desktop floor, and never while the operator is at the desk -- on 2026-09-04 a 3-card engine at util 0.87-0.90 left it under 1 GB, Windows fell to a 720p-class mode and the operator had to reboot (clean event log, no TDR: starvation, not a crash). The template pins NOTHING to device 1 and a render test asserts it. PIN BY GPU UUID, NEVER INDEX: two of the three cards report the identical board name 'RTX 5060 Ti', and CUDA/ComfyUI ordering does not match nvidia-smi PCI order. AGENT SEAT stays the 2-card-pinned 27B, on measurement: the 3-card vLLM seat FAILED the delegation gate -- a real harness digest contract DEFERRED at 300,010 ms where the two-card seat finished the same contract in 272 s -- so three-card serving is opt-in long-context work, not the delegation lane. THE 3-CARD SEATS THAT DID EARN THEIR PLACE are rendered as opt-in entries: qwen3.8-flash-next at ncmoe28 / --tensor-split 28,10,10 / q8_0 KV / 131k (12.5-12.9 tok/s, +47% over the best 2-card arm, and 15/16 on the seed-48 decision set = exact parity with the 27B incumbent), plus its native-262k twin at ncmoe32 / 32,8,8 (pp 69, tg 11.3 tok/s, needle exact at 11.4k depth; a full 200k prompt is ~48 min of prefill, so batch only). CUDA graphs are ON for the 26B seats (measured 2026-09-05: gen 41.4 -> 58.0 and 39.0 -> 58.8 tok/s, output identical); GGML_CUDA_GRAPH_OPT stays off (changes output, crashes the MTP 12b). MEDIA: ComfyUI does not shard a DiT, so extra cards buy parallel renders and weight-donor storage, never a bigger single render -- the bf16 LTX transformer still OOMs on the COMPUTE device's activations at 1920x1088, which a donor card cannot fix, and int8 DiTs cannot compute on a non-default CUDA device at all (ComfyUI-MultiGPU #220), so videogen is pinned to cuda:0/cuda:1 as a documented law exception. Evidence: Benchmarks and Optimizations/2026-08-31-48gb-gates-NOTES.md, 2026-09-01-vllm-lmcache-results/, 2026-09-03-seat-optimization-program.md, 2026-09-05-cudax/. NOT to be confused with blackwell-48, which is ONE RTX PRO 5000 48GB card. MEDIA PLACEMENT CORRECTED 2026-09-07 (0.113.33) TO THE MEASURED LIVE PLACEMENT: this tier's ENTIRE media block was a byte-for-byte copy of blackwell-2x16's, whose gpu_env map is 0=utility / 1=FAST. On THREE cards the gpu_env map is 0=5060 Ti / 1=5070 Ti DISPLAY / 2=5060 Ti, so the copy pinned the vision seat onto the display card and named card 2 nowhere -- which is the whole reason the 3-card box measured no media difference from the 2-card box. It was an unadapted copy, not a hardware finding. TWO DEVICE ORDERINGS ARE IN PLAY AND THE DISPLAY CARD HAS A DIFFERENT INDEX IN EACH -- gpu_env is CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES under CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID (display = 1), while the ComfyUI pool keys are 'cuda:N' in ComfyUI's FASTEST-FIRST order (display = cuda:0, the pair = cuda:1/cuda:2). Applied, matching what the reference box actually runs (verified in both live config files and the live llama-swap header): vision seat CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES 1 -> 2 and STT 0 -> 2, the 2026-08-31 G1 singles rebalance that moved whisper, vl-8b/ocr and the embed/rerank alternates to 5060Ti#2 while the cascade + memory-stack residents stayed on card 0 (re-measured 2026-09-05: vl-8b 11,751 MiB on card 2); imagegen_pool_compute cuda:0 -> cuda:1 with donor cuda:2, the pair, bf16 and re-verified there after the 2026-09-01 revert with two 1568x880 Krea 2 Turbo stills. VIDEOGEN IS UNCHANGED AND MUST STAY cuda:0/cuda:1: an int8 DiT cannot compute on a non-default CUDA device (ComfyUI-MultiGPU #220) and the 2026-09-01 attempt to move it threw cudaErrorIllegalAddress mid-render, so its compute genuinely belongs on the display card as a documented law exception. Do not 'restore' the vision seat to device 1: at 11,751 MiB it would leave ~3.5 GiB after the ~0.5-1.5 GB DWM tax, under the >=4 GiB desktop floor set by the 2026-09-04 starvation (720p-class mode, reboot, clean event log). Operator decision 2026-09-07: the 5070 Ti is CONTEXT/KV ONLY -- it may grow the KV pool for long-context seats (137,898 tokens across three cards vs 78,506 across two) and the named opt-in over-2-card seats may span it, but no tier seat is pinned to it. Gated by TestTripleBlackwellNeverSchedulesOntoTheDisplayCard (profiles.json, both orderings) and by two placement assertions in setup/render.tests.ps1 (rendered yaml). VISION SEAT UPGRADED 2026-09-08 (0.113.35): qwen3-vl-8b -> qwen3-vl-32b for VISION, with the 8B KEEPING OCR. This is a quality binding and the tier was shipping the loser of its own bake-off. 48 GB gates on the reference box: visioncanary MMMU 0.740 vs the 8B's 0.630 (+11 points, clears the >=8 promotion bar) -> the 32B takes vision; DocVQA ANLS 0.928 (-3.7) plus a dense-transcription regression -> the 8B keeps OCR. The split is itself quality-driven: each role goes to the model that measured better AT THAT ROLE, which is why this must not be collapsed back to one seat. The decision was APPLIED on the box (both live config files bind vision_model=qwen3-vl-32b and ocr_model=qwen3-vl-8b, and the running llama-swap serves both) and the tier table was simply never updated, so every fresh install of the tier whose reference box IS that machine got a measured 11-point MMMU regression. Flags are the measured ones: -sm tensor --tensor-split 25,25 on the 5060 Ti pair (CUDA-X 2026-09-05 moved it from -sm layer at the same split and got BYTE-IDENTICAL output 5/5 on a fixed image+prompt while generation went 19.6 -> 34.1 t/s -- identical output is what makes it free rather than a trade), --image-min-tokens 1024 as the visual-token FLOOR, and Qwen3-VL's official sampler (temp 0.7 / top-p 0.8 / top-k 20) pinned as a set. CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,2 -- a 32B does not fit one 16 GB card and device 1 is the display card. NOT PROPAGATED TO blackwell-2x16: this seat spans BOTH cards of its pair, and on the 2-card tier the second card is the one paying the desktop/DWM tax, so a 2-card box would be asked to give ~25 GB of its 32 GB to a swappable vision seat. That tier needs its own fit measurement before it inherits this. Gated by TestTripleBlackwellVisionSeatIsTheMeasuredWinner.
